who.value: seller with chats from a suspended buyer account

job.value: Understand that a chat partner's account is suspended and handle (archive) that chat

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: It's clearly 'All chats', and one row says 'Account suspended', but the first screen doesn't show the archive banner or action this design is about.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: Nothing on the first screen tells the seller what to do with the suspended chat; the 'Account suspended' row has no action.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: The X, check and search icons in the header have no labels, so their effect (close? select?) isn't predictable.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'Account suspended' appears with no hint of what it means for the seller (can't reply? item still listed?).

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: No decision is forced on this screen.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: The suspended state is a single red line on the row.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: An inbox notice about a suspended partner fits the chat stage.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Rows are short; no explanatory text.
